notes: Callback phishing: fake PayPal invoice with a scam phone number. Image alt text 'PayPal Binance Phishing Sample Email'. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Hard case: no link, no payment method, only a phone number and 'today'.
